title: A 2,700-Year-Old Eclipse Helps Measure Earth’s Spin
paragraphs: A very old eclipse is helping scientists. It happened in China in 709 BCE. That is about 2,700 years ago.
Old books describe the eclipse. The Moon covered the whole Sun for a short time. But scientists had a problem. They put an old city in the wrong place.
The scientists fixed the place by 8 kilometres. Now the old story and the maths agree. The eclipse also shows how fast the Earth turned long ago.

questions.q: By how much did the scientists fix the place of the city?
